title: JJS Justice
description: jjsjustice.com JJS Justice (Janet, Janet & Suggs, LLC) is a national plaintiff-side firm based in Baltimore/Pikesville, MD, founded 1996 (practice since 1978) — specializing in birth injuries/CP, medical malpractice, sexual abuse (clergy, USC/Johns Hopkins), mass torts, and whistleblower cases. Record: $3B+ in verdicts and settlements over 40 years, including the largest US sexual-abuse settlement ($852M vs. USC/Dr. Tyndall, 2021), $190M vs. Johns Hopkins, $225M NJ v. ExxonMobil, and multiple record birth-injury verdicts. Led since Sept 2025 by Andrew S. Janet after founder Howard A. Janet died at 70; core team includes Kenneth M. Suggs (ex-ATLA president) and Dr. Giles Manley (OBGYN turned lawyer). Chambers USA Band 2 (MD plaintiffs), Best Lawyers "Lawyer of the Year" 2025, Super Lawyers, Lawdragon 500, AV Preeminent, ABOTA. Contingency model (no fee unless they win), 10+ states + DC, ~17 lawyers, ~60 staff.
